_note: Audition pool (ElevenLabs, eleven_v3): an EDITABLE PRESET with example entries, kept in step with references/launch-vo.md 'Voice stage'. Replace every voiceId with a voice from your own ElevenLabs library before a real (non-mock) run; a REPLACE_ placeholder is refused by common/el.py. The FIRST entry per language is the locked voice (recommended); the others are alternatives one dimension apart. `retired` holds superseded voices: voice/audition.py offers them only with --include-retired (lookups by id still resolve them, so an old run's pick keeps working). mock = the local TTS stand-in in mock mode (a macOS `say` voice; espeak-ng variants on Linux). spell = how the TTS text spells the brand for that voice (display text keeps the brand's display form).
